answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Deviant Sects Question ID: 894 Country: United States of America Title: Is there any difference between scholars of Imami Shias and their laymen, as Mufti Rasheed Ahmed Ludhanvi didnt make any distingtuion between them? Question: Is there any difference between scholars of Imami Shias and their laymen, as Mufti Rasheed Ahmed Ludhanvi didnt make any distingtuion between them? Answer ID: 894 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 717=676/B) The Imamia Shias are out of fold of Islam like Isna Ashari Shias. And, when their laymen also follow their Ulama then they also will be counted in the same category. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
